title: SLO synthesis runbook and active golden-signal prober for multi-region failover
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: Deliver an operationally actionable artifact that translates token-level latency SLIs into region-aware SLO targets, paired with an active golden-signal prober and a dashboard/runbook combo that surfaces pre-failure conditions and drives automated circuit threshold tuning. Scope: 1) Define SLO synthesis algorithm (cohorting, prefix weighting, p95/p99 translation to admit thresholds). 2) Implement active prober that generates synthetic tokenized workloads across regions and priority classes and emits telemetry to the observability pipeline. 3) Dashboard buildout: pre-failure signal canvases, anomaly timelines, admission/circuit state, and recommended mitigation actions. Out of scope: full rollout automation for canary deployments (follow-up ticket).
acceptance_criteria: 1) SLO synthesis job produces daily region-level SLO recommendations (CSV + UI) for p95/p99 token latencies. 2) Active prober runs from each region, sends synthetic traces with token annotations; we get KV cache hit rates correlated with synthetic workloads. 3) New dashboard contains panels for: per-region synthesized SLO, synthetic vs production latency overlays, circuit state timeline, token-cohort histograms, and a mitigation checklist card. 4) Runbook steps for incident responders with playbook links and one-click links to reroute policies. 5) Tests: prober chaos scenarios reproduce expected dashboard signals in staging.
implementation_notes: SLO synthesis: use 7-day rolling windows, cohort by sequence-length buckets (0-64,65-256,256+), and weight by token-volume per tenant. Translate p95/p99 into admit-score hysteresis bands using logistic smoothing to avoid flapping. Prober: re-use synthetic traffic harness from ENG-48888 with enhancements: tokenized prompt templates, KV-prefetch toggles, and priority flag. Instrumentation: emit events to tracing pipeline with attributes: region, shard, model_variant, sequence_length_bucket, kv_hit, decode_path_ms, token_index. Storage: push summary histograms to ClickHouse and time-series aggregates to Prometheus for SLO scoring. Dashboard: Grafana mixed panels + Timeseries and Heatmap for cohort exposures. Alerts: staged alert rules targeting on-call with runbook link.
risks_and_tradeoffs: - Active probing increases noise on production clusters; we limit probe rate and use dedicated low-priority admission where available. - SLO synthesis complexity vs interpretability: a simpler rolling percentile may be more auditable but less adaptive. We prioritize explainability in UI with a transparent formula and a CSV export. - Translating token-level metrics to admission thresholds can cause false-positives during model cold-starts; mitigation: cooldown windows and model-variant annotations.
design_feedback: PM Priya: prioritize clear mapping from SLO recommendation to specific admission policy fields (thresholds, hysteresis).
Design Liam: dashboard must include a one-line explanation of SLO synthesis method and a toggle to view raw cohort contributions.
Security Sam: ensure prober payloads contain no customer data and are signed; we will use a synthetic prompt corpus maintained in the org vault.
